scope: Preserve v0.9 interior assets and task engine; application-owned persistent ambient city with independent traffic timing, improved vehicle/pedestrian geometry, density controls and passive environment interactions.

preservation.api_changes: Only two release-version strings; no business-logic changes.

limits: Software GPU sample only; hardware GPU smoothness not verified.
Browser DOM/WebGL uses existing restricted HTTP bridge; native deployment URL/TLS/storage requires local verification.
No real LLM, Docker/gVisor or Temporal/PostgreSQL full-stack validation claimed.
Ambient simulation runs per logged-in browser app, not a 24/7 server-side or multi-client synchronized world.
Offline wheels target Linux x86_64 / CPython 3.13 compatible system libraries and are repackaged with provenance.
contents: Source, prebuilt formal frontend, offline dependencies, tests, docs and observed evidence. No demo entrypoint, runtime data, keys, fonts or venv.
